name: zellij-indicator-v2-fork
description: Vendored fork of opencode-zellij-indicator@2.0.0 for OpenCode 2. Patches: compact tabs by default (status icon only), optional OPENCODE_ZELLIJ_TITLE_MAX title with truncation (upstream 2.0.0 does neither); hand-rolled default export so the plugin needs no node_modules; server/rpc stub entrypoints so V2's loader resolves the directory without throwing.
